The PromoBento contributors dedicate the original geometry, bitmap glyph patterns,
animation, synthetic application-screen frames, procedural scores and waveforms,
and fictional sample copy in this directory to the public domain under
CC0 1.0: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

No customer assets, commercial factual claims or third-party music are included.
The registered third-party font files are covered by their retained notices in
fonts/ and the exact source/license records in media-assets.json, not by this CC0
dedication. Generated media retains this source and license reference in its
resource manifest before it is decoded, mixed or rendered.

These are engineering render fixtures, not paid customer works.
